create_prolific_study: create a new Prolific study in the datastore with study id, link, duration, and task run id
register_run: register a new task run in the datastore with workspace id, project id, and study config path
create_unit: create a unit in the datastore linking unit id, task run id, and prolific study id
register_submission: register a submission to a Prolific study with study id, unit id, and submission id
find_studies_by_status: find all studies in the datastore matching or excluding specific status values
